title: Textures on 6-node triangles
author: Claude-JG
description: Maintainer 2026-10-18: a TriangleList with triangles6 and texture coordinates per point; first way: the textured 6-node triangles are split into four flat textured triangles when they are read, the texture coordinates of the mid-side nodes as given.
releaseNotes: 6-node triangles with a texture are drawn as the four flat triangles on their nodes; SC.renderer.GetGraphicsData() returns the textured triangles under texturedTriangles (revision2026c step RG6.11.3)
